answers.workaround:
This seemed to be the best I could figure:
```gdscript
if (anim_player.current_animation_position > 0.0 && anim_player.current_animation_length - anim_player.current_animation_position > 0.1):
```

Edit: Looking at the engine code, both pause() and stop() call _stop_internal() and there's nothing that distinguishes a pause from a stop which is why there's no straightforward way to check if it was paused!
